text: Ritual Chalk marks totems and is spent doing it. This is the other kind: a builder's stick, kept for measuring. Hold it and it stands a **hologram** of a shape in the world — a ghost block in every space the shape still needs — so you lay real blocks inside the ghosts instead of counting and hoping.
It never wears out, and it places nothing and breaks nothing. The hologram is drawn on your own screen alone; nobody else sees it, and the server does no work for it.

pages.title: Working it
text: **Use** it to change shape. **Sneak and right-click** to grow it, **sneak and left-click** to shrink it; the size wraps round at either end. Sneaking with the chalk out never breaks a block, so you can size it standing inside your own walls.

**Use it on a block to set the layout down.** The hologram stops following you and stands on that spot — and it keeps standing while the chalk sits **anywhere in your hotbar**, so you can put it away, take up blocks and build inside the ghosts. Use it on the same spot again to rub the mark out.
A chalk with no mark set only draws while it is in your hand, so a layout never trails your feet while you are swinging a pickaxe.
A ghost stands only where a block is still wanted. Fill one and it goes out, so what is left glowing is exactly what is left to build.

pages.title: Size
text: Sizes run from **2** to **128**, measured out from the mark — so the largest circle is **257 blocks across**. The step opens out as it grows, fine near a hut and coarse near a curtain wall, so the whole range is eighteen flicks rather than a hundred and twenty-six.
The hologram reaches about **48 blocks**, and on a shape big enough to flood the view it draws in closer rather than thinning out. Walk the line and it keeps up with you.

pages.title: The shapes
text: - **Square**, **Circle**, **Cross** and **Hexagon**: flat outlines for a footprint.
- **Walls**: a square footprint stood up three courses, which is a room.
- **Dome**: the shell of a hemisphere, for a roof.
- **Hut**: four walls with a doorway on one face and a stepped roof above them.
- **Longhouse**: a hall twice as long as it is wide, with a ridge beam and two gables.
- **Lattice camp**: the square a machine at the mark really reaches, and the four spots a Resonance Totem would stand on to carry that reach outward.

pages.title: Why the square, and not a circle
text: Every Pulse scan in the camp measures each direction on its own, so a machine's reach is a **cube**, not a ball. A block eight east and eight north of a generator is in range; one ten blocks due east is not, however much closer the second looks on a map.
That is why **Lattice camp** draws a square. Set it to **8** and it is exactly the zone a Drumheart, a station or a Lattice Conductor works within.
